articles.title: Conservatives stunned by 'catastrophic' midterm blue tsunami, blame Trump's Iran war, high gas prices
articles.description: Conservatives reacted to massive Democratic victories across the country, calling it "catastrophic" and assigning blame to the Iran war and President Trump.

articles.title: Democrats Seize Control of Congress, Ending a G.O.P. Trifecta
articles.description: The party’s victory in the House cemented an era of divided government and a freshly assertive Congress after two years in which Republicans ceded power to President Trump.

related.title: Gold, silver and precious metals prices jump, dollar dips as Democrats take control of Congress
related.description: Precious metals saw strong gains on Tuesday morning, as investors digested a Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterm elections.
related.normalizedTitle: gold silver and precious metals prices jump dollar dips as democrats take control of congress

articles.title: Bobby Pulido, a Tejano Music Star, Flips a House Seat in Texas for Democrats
articles.description: Mr. Pulido, a Latin Grammy Award-winning singer and conservative Democrat, ousted a Republican incumbent in a district President Trump won by 18 percentage points in 2024.

articles.title: Democrat Unseats House Republican in Iowa, Flipping an Important Seat
articles.description: Discontent about the war with Iran and tariffs helped create a tough environment for Representative Mariannette Miller-Meeks, the defeated Republican.

articles.title: Netanyahu faces coalition showdown as rivals maneuver to form Israel's next government
articles.description: Benjamin Netanyahu faces a critical test as President Isaac Herzog decides who will receive the mandate to form Israel's next government.

articles.title: Trump congratulates Democrats after dominant midterms, says he looks forward to working with them
articles.description: President Donald Trump congratulated Democrats, saying he looked forward to working with them following a devastating Election Day for Republicans.

articles.title: El-Sayed Wins Michigan Senate Race in a Victory for Democrats
articles.description: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed will become the nation’s first Muslim senator. He triumphed in one of the country’s most bitter and expensive races, keeping his party in control of a crucial seat.

related.title: Abdul El-Sayed delivers major blow to GOP in Michigan after bruising Senate race
related.description: Abdul El-Sayed toppled Mike Rogers to become the first Muslim U.S. senator, overcoming Trump's attacks on his faith and alleged foreign ties.
related.normalizedTitle: abdul el sayed delivers major blow to gop in michigan after bruising senate race

articles.title: Collins Falls to Jackson in Maine, Ending a Three-Decade Senate Tenure
articles.description: Senator Susan Collins, the sole Republican representing New England in Congress, lost her seat on a landslide night for Democrats.

articles.title: With 2 Big Wins, Democrats May Have Put Ohio Back in Play
articles.description: Once seen as a bellwether of the nation’s political mood, Ohio has been solidly red since President Trump first won office. Tuesday’s results could change that.

articles.title: Democrat Defeats Nunn in Iowa, Scoring a Key House Pickup
articles.description: Sarah Trone Garriott, a Democratic state senator and Lutheran minister, beat Representative Zach Nunn, a Republican who had tied himself closely to President Trump.

articles.title: Historic Midterm Rout Serves as a Sweeping Rebuke of Trump Era
articles.description: The electoral backlash extended even into deep red states and indicated that President Trump has lost his hold over the coalition that lifted him to the White House twice.

articles.title: Jocelyn Benson Holds Michigan Governor’s Office for Democrats
articles.description: Ms. Benson, the secretary of state, defeated Representative John James in a swing state that often plays a critical role in presidential elections.

articles.title: Rebecca Bennett Unseats Tom Kean Jr. in New Jersey House Race
articles.description: Rebecca Bennett, a Democrat, unseated Representative Tom Kean Jr. in a New Jersey swing district. Mr. Kean was absent from Congress for nearly four months while he was treated for depression.

articles.title: ‘An Earthquake’: A Democratic Rout Stuns Texas
articles.description: In a seismic shift that was once unthinkable, victories by James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa upended decades of statewide dominance in what had been the nation’s most populous conservative state.

articles.title: Moderate Republican Loses Seat in Pennsylvania Swing District
articles.description: Bob Harvie, a Bucks County commissioner, defeated Representative Brian Fitzpatrick, who had survived three previous elections in a district that voted against President Trump each time.

articles.title: How the Stock Market Is Reacting to the Midterm Elections
articles.description: U.S. stock futures and Asian semiconductor shares dropped as investors weighed the future of the artificial intelligence boom.

articles.title: Letitia James Wins Third Consecutive Term in New York Attorney General Race
articles.description: With President Trump a focus of the race, Ms. James overcame a challenge from a Republican former federal prosecutor, Saritha Komatireddy.

articles.title: Winning the Senate, Democrats Secure a Platform to Check Trump
articles.description: In a stunning string of victories in Iowa, Texas, and North and South Carolina, Democrats delivered a midterm thrashing repudiating President Trump.

articles.title: Haaland and Flanagan, Two Native American Women, Break Political Barriers
articles.description: Deb Haaland of New Mexico will be the nation’s first woman Native American governor, while Peggy Flanagan, Minnesota’s next senator, is the first Native American woman to win election to the chamber.

articles.title: Democrat Wins a Kansas Senate Seat for the First Time Since 1932
articles.description: The Rev. Adam Hamilton, a centrist Democrat, ousted Senator Roger Marshall, a Republican who was bogged down by President Trump’s unpopularity.

articles.title: U.K. Supreme Court to Hear Challenge to Ban on Palestine Action: What to Know
articles.description: The government designated the protest group as a terrorist organization last year, prompting criticism. The country’s Supreme Court is set to begin hearing a challenge to the ban on Wednesday.

articles.title: Treasury yields fall as investors crowd into bonds for safety amid election stock sell-off
articles.description: Treasury yields fell on Tuesday night, as investors sought shelter from a sell-off in equity futures sparked by big victories from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections.

articles.title: Thune plans to run for Republican minority leader after Dem's midterm takeover
articles.description: John Thune intends to run for Senate minority leader after Republicans lost at least five seats in the 2026 midterm elections, a source says.

articles.title: 'Pod Save America' hosts call Democratic Party's midterm wins 'the end of the Trump era'
articles.description: "Pod Save America" hosts celebrated Democratic midterm wins on "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" Tuesday night as the party was projected to retake control of Congress.

articles.title: U.S. midterm elections in pictures: Democrats' sweeping victories deliver rebuke to Trump
articles.description: Democrats scored sweeping victories in the U.S. midterm elections on Wednesday, flipping key Republican-held seats in Congress.

articles.title: My Call With President Trump
articles.description: Our White House correspondents Tyler Pager and Erica L. Green called President Trump to ask whether he would accept the results of the election.

articles.title: Jimmy Kimmel Rides Election Day’s ‘Blue Tsunami’
articles.description: “Man, oh man, would I hate to be the DoorDash driver who delivers Trump his Papa Johns tonight,” Kimmel said.

articles.title: Candy and Smiles on MS NOW, and Some Regrets on Fox News
articles.description: On TV, the outcome of the midterm elections became clear early on. Pundits celebrated and grieved by turns.

articles.title: A Democratic Senator for Kansas
articles.description: Democrats won a Senate seat in Kansas for the first time in nearly 100 years. Our election data reporter Christine Zhang talks about the growing Democratic footprint in the state.

articles.title: Democrats Outperform in Three States
articles.description: Democrats have won key Senate races in Georgia, North Carolina and South Carolina. Our election data reporter Evan Reynolds explains how Democrats did well even in some historically Republican counties in these Southern states.

articles.title: Texas’ Hispanic Voters
articles.description: In the race for U.S. Senate in Texas, Republicans forfeited gains that President Trump made among Hispanic voters in 2024. Our election data reporter Christine Zhang explains.

articles.title: How Gina Hinojosa Captured Texas
articles.description: The woman who took down Greg Abbott concentrated on pocketbook issues, but voters’ opposition to Republican immigration policies was a tailwind.

articles.title: Idaho Voters Reject Referendum to Lift State’s Abortion Ban
articles.description: Proponents of the initiative had blamed the abortion ban on a steep decline in the number of obstetricians and gynecologists in the state, but they could not overcome Idaho’s conservatism.

articles.title: These Wins Could Mint a New Generation of Democratic Stars
articles.description: Voters from South Carolina to Ohio to Texas have elevated a new class of Democrats who could not be more different from one another.

articles.title: Bomb Threats Disrupt Several Flights Across Europe
articles.description: Officials are investigating threats against at least seven planes. The aircraft landed safely and no explosives were found, the authorities said.

articles.title: Across the Country, Voters Give Direct Orders to State Governments
articles.description: Many of the more than 140 ballot questions on voting rights, redistricting and voter identification laws. Others set rules for taxes and transgender people in sports.

articles.title: Five Things to Know About Hakeem Jeffries
articles.description: The New York Democrat who is in line to be the first Black speaker was raised by a Black nationalist family in Brooklyn, is a moderate and loves a hip-hop reference.

articles.title: Max Miller Loses in Ohio After Ex-Wife’s Abuse Allegations
articles.description: The defeat of the two-term Republican by Brian Poindexter, a union ironworker, handed Democrats a seat that had appeared out of reach before the family clash became public.

articles.title: Gina Hinojosa Wins Texas Governor Race in Major Upset, Defeating Greg Abbott
articles.description: State Representative Gina Hinojosa defeated Gov. Greg Abbott, denying him a fourth term and becoming the first Hispanic candidate elected to lead the state.

articles.title: How Ken Paxton Went From Republican Survivor to Republican Liability
articles.description: For years, Ken Paxton turned scandal into a test of Republican loyalty, but his Senate defeat exposed the limits of a political strategy that helped reshape Texas.

articles.title: This Is a Huge Psychological Blow to Republicans
articles.description: For Republicans, Texas has long been a dependable political anchor. Now, it’s finally blue.

articles.title: Xavier Becerra Becomes California’s First Latino Elected as Governor, Defeating Steve Hilton
articles.description: Xavier Becerra, a Democrat who has served in various roles at the state and federal level, will succeed Gov. Gavin Newsom.

articles.title: Josh Turek Flips Iowa Senate Seat in a Major Victory for Democrats
articles.description: Mr. Turek, a Paralympian and state representative, defeated Representative Ashley Hinson, a Republican, in one of this year’s top Senate races.

articles.title: ‘We Hear You,’ Says Jeffries, Who Is Set to Break Barrier in House
articles.description: Hakeem Jeffries, Democrat of New York, would make history as the first Black speaker of the House.

articles.title: Novo shares jump 6% as Wegovy pill sales impress, drugmaker hikes outlook
articles.description: Novo posted quarterly earnings ahead of expectations early Wednesday as sales of its Wegovy pill blew past estimates
